summary: BioHarvest Sciences filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 14, 2026 news release announcing that CEO Zaki Rakib will present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, held September 14-16, 2026, in New York City, with a company presentation on September 15, 2026 at 4:00 PM ET and one-on-one investor meetings. The release references recent CDMO research and development progress, including a first manufacturing and supply agreement. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine investor-conference scheduling announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
